content:
Nia (Growth): Heads-up: we're doing a compact social push for the upcoming webinar "Northstar": focus on product benchmarks + practical tradeoffs. Deliverables: 2 X posts (tease + demo highlight), 1 LinkedIn carousel, and targeted DMs to warm accounts. Target: 200 signups, 20 enterprise conversations.

Omar (Content): I'll create two thread openers and a 3-slide LinkedIn carousel. Need hero PNG (1200x628) and a short motion GIF (4s) showing response time comparison. Can deliver if assets are in the drive by 3pm.

Rita (Demand): I'll extract the warm list (top 800 in last 60d). We'll tag leads with "northstar_webinar". Proposal for A/B headline test: "Predictable LLM latency, real demos" vs "Lower inference spend without sacrificing quality". Shortlinks will be seeded per variant.

Chris (Ops): Proposed schedule (PDT): X tease Tue 09:30, X demo peek Wed 10:00, LinkedIn Wed 10:10. Seed DMs 30-60m after each post to top-priority accounts. I'll prepare a CSV for Buffer import.

Nia (Growth): DMs only to contacts with engagement score > 65 and enterprise flag. Keep the sign-up form minimal (email only). Use UTMs: utm_campaign=northstar&utm_source={channel}&utm_medium=social&utm_content={variant}.

Omar (Content): Draft copy samples:
- "What predictable inference looks like in production. Live demo + numbers."
- "See practical configs that cut unit cost while keeping output quality. Join our walkthrough."

Rita (Demand): Seeds + shortlinks: https://rwd.ai/northA and https://rwd.ai/northB. I'll queue warm-list email 10m after the first X post. SDRs: confirm capacity if we hit 250+ signups pls. @SDR Team

SDR Team: We can handle 180 immediate follow-ups. If over 180, prioritize enterprise and accounts with >80 engagement. We'll mark senior reps for enterprise.

Chris (Ops): CSV for scheduler (sample row):
"platform,iso_time,variant,asset,link,utm"
"X,2026-05-12T16:30:00Z,teaseA,hero_north_v1.png,https://rwd.ai/northA,utm_campaign=northstar&utm_content=teaseA"
"X,2026-05-13T17:00:00Z,peekB,hero_north_v1_alt.png,https://rwd.ai/northB,utm_campaign=northstar&utm_content=peekB"
"LinkedIn,2026-05-13T17:10:00Z,carousel1,carousel_assets.zip,https://rwd.ai/northstar,utm_campaign=northstar&utm_source=linkedin"

Chris (Ops): I'll set an alert to forward replies that include the shortlink or the words "register"/"sign up" to the tracking sheet and tag SDRs. We'll batch DMs in 20-min windows to avoid spamming reps.

Omar (Content): Upload location: https://drive.redwood/marketing/northstar-drafts. I'll annotate alt text and a short accessibility blurb.

Nia (Growth): Quick EOD checklist: Omar upload assets, Rita seed links + email queue, Chris import CSV + alerts, SDR Team share prioritization doc. Quick 10-min standup tomorrow 08:45 PT for pre-launch final.

MarketingBot: Drafts saved to scheduler. Approval reminder set for 16:00 PT. Campaign tags applied: campaign=northstar, channel=social.

Rita (Demand): Warm list ready, shortlinks live.

Omar (Content): Assets will be uploaded in 30m.

SDR Team: Prioritization doc shared: https://docs.redwood/sdr/northstar-priority.

Nia (Growth): Thanks all 525 ping this thread for any last-minute issues.
